title: Shinonome Ena — Restock Time!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Gym
se_walk_women_005_2
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We're back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone! We bought lots and lots of paint☆

rows.Speaker: Set Designer
rows.Line: Welcome back, Shinonome, Otori, Mochizuki! Thanks for doing that supply run.

rows.Speaker: Set Designer
rows.Line:
Carrying all this couldn't have been easy.
I'll take that plywood off your hands, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Please be careful, though, since there's more than one in this stack.

rows.Speaker: Set Designer
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm sure you're all tired, so go ahead and take a break.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks. Then, we'll rest and sort out everything we just bought.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Phew... This bag was so heavy...
It really feels like we bought a ton of paint...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for your help, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We were able to get everything we needed in short order, thanks to your help.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah♪ That was so cool☆
You knew exactly which floor and aisle everything was♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I shop there a lot, so I do basically know where everything is.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, we need to sort all the stuff we bought. The paint in particular, since we have a few groups who had to stop after running out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, I'll go around and gather up the empty paint bottles.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, and once we refill them, they can get back to work.
se_walk_women_005_2

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I remember them telling me yesterday about how they all ran out...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And I had them help the other groups in the meantime. But this means they're probably behind schedule now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (They'll still probably finish in time for the show, but I want them to have a buffer on that. Which means we need to make up for the time we lost.)

rows.Speaker: Set Designer
rows.Line:
Oww, my legs...
I need to take a break.

rows.Speaker: Set Designer
rows.Line: Yeah, we've been sitting for so long that my body's starting to get all stiff.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Everyone's starting to look exhausted...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (To be honest, I was feeling the same way. Going out shopping was actually a pretty nice break.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (We're in the final stretch of the preparation period, and the fatigue that's built up is gonna make it hard to get things done as efficiently. In other words, making up for lost time is gonna be next to impossible.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whoa...! Is something wrong, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I just got a message on my phone♪ Gimme a second to go and get them☆

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Get who?

rows.Speaker: Set Designer
rows.Line: Maybe Kusanagi's here to see how we're doing again...

rows.Speaker: Set Designer
rows.Line: But she usually tells us in advance that she'll be visiting.
We knew that you guys were working at our school, but not that you'd be here in the gym!
It makes sense, given how big it sounds like the sets are.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, everyone! We come with yummy snacks!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Minori!

rows.Speaker: Set Designer
rows.Line:
What?!
M-Minori and Haruka?! From MORE MORE JUMP!?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry, we didn't mean to startle any of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our groupmates, Airi Momoi and Shizuku Hinomori, are participating, and we're also students here in Shibuya, after all. So we wanted to help out in any way we could.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That explains the snacks.
Thanks, Minori, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyway, we have chilled fruit jelly for all of you! Tell us which flavors you'd like and we'll hand them to you!

rows.Speaker: Set Designer
rows.Line: Y-You're giving them to us directly?!

rows.Speaker: Set Designer
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What do I do?!
Do I ask Minori or Haruka?! I can't choose!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wow, everyone seems to be feeling much better now all of a sudden...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's go grab some jelly, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu, before I forget...
Are they the ones who messaged you earlier?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆ They said that they wanted to bring us a surprise♪ So, I asked Honami to see when would be best!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, Honami, you also knew?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They really chose the perfect moment to ask if they could visit.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It seemed like we were all starting to feel the fatigue, now that we're in the final stretch.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup♪
I hope this helps cheer everybody up!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me too. Festivals like these don't come around often, so I want them to have fun until the end...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey! Ena, you guys! Come grab your jelly!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, be right there!
